summary: Thunderbird Freezing/Crashing due to memory leak
description:
User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/95.0.4638.54 Safari/537.36

Steps to reproduce:

1. Open Thunderbird
2. Check email
3. Freezes due to a huge memory leak
4. Crashes

I use version 94.0b4 (64-bit) on Windows 11

Actual results:

When I click on emails the whole client will freeze and then crash.

Expected results:

I should be able to check my emails without having to reopen Thunderbird multiple times just to get through the emails. I have resorted to checking email on the web due to this issue.
